map.预计完成日为什么有时比预期早很多？: Why Is the Estimated Completion Date Sometimes Much Earlier Than Expected?
map.完成日 = 今天 + 剩余学时÷每日投入小时，向上取整到整天；若剩余学时少或日投: Completion day = today + remaining hours ÷ daily input hours, rounded up to a whole day; with few hours left or high daily input it naturally comes earlier. Note that it assumes you can reliably put in the set hours every day — real leave or interruptions push it later, so keep a buffer.
map.单任务耗时怎么估计更准？: How Can I Estimate Per-Task Time More Accurately?
map.用「该科目近期真实完成若干任务的平均耗时」作 hours，比拍脑袋准；完成后再回: Use "the actual average time for recently completed tasks in this subject" as hours — far better than guessing — and fill in the real values afterwards so the tool gets closer to your true pace as data accumulates. Progress counts tasks without weighting difficulty, so break heavy tasks into smaller ones for a smoother curve.
